description.value:
Requirement There is a plausible improvised firearm, tool, or scrap weapon within reach.

Pick it up and make it work. Until the end of the encounter, treat the object as a scrap gun of a simple firearm type of your choice with a Failure Range, using your own weapon proficiency. It falls apart at the end of the encounter regardless of what happens to it.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Failure Range) — same arbitrary-object-to-weapon templating problem as a-gun-is-just-a-tube. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
